# Bagatur BJJ Burgas

> Bulgarian-first Brazilian Jiu-Jitsu academy in Burgas, Bulgaria, with classes for children and adults. The official website is also available in Russian and English.

Bagatur BJJ Burgas teaches Brazilian Jiu-Jitsu in a controlled training environment focused on technique, discipline, confidence, self-control and respect. The academy is located at 2 Odrin Street, 8000 Burgas. Trial training is arranged by calling the coach directly.

## Contact

- Academy: Bagatur BJJ Burgas
- Address: ул. Одрин 2, 8000 Бургас, България
- Phone: +359 877 069 665
- Trial class: call the coach at +359 877 069 665
- Primary language: Bulgarian
- Additional website languages: Russian and English

## Training groups

- Children aged 4–7
- Children aged 8–14
- Adults aged 14+, beginners and advanced practitioners
